cands.bio: Democratic member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 78 (Montgomery) since September 2021, first elected in a special election. Previously urban director of Young Life of Montgomery, manager of Heritage Barbershop, and campaign manager and strategist for legislator Kirk Hatcher.

endorsements.text: Tabitha's List: Candidates You Can Trust (a Sway voting group by Tabitha Isner) recommended him in 2026, per Ballotpedia.

cands.gaps: We found no documented stances or actions by Hassell on data centers, homestead property taxes, land ownership by investors or foreigners, growth and land conservation, H-1B or immigration enforcement, police pay, gun laws, abortion, or school choice and teacher pay. The page we read lists his sponsored bills only as an empty table, so we can't say what he sponsored besides a 2023 bill to remove Robert E. Lee's birthday as a state holiday, which died in committee. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate surveys in 2021, 2022 or 2026, and we found no campaign-site statements. We couldn't find where he was raised, when or whether he moved to Alabama, or any controversies, foreign ties, or public land-use stances.

qual.background: Alabama House member since September 2021 (about five years). Before that he was a Young Life Montgomery urban director, barbershop manager, and campaign manager and strategist for Kirk Hatcher.
qual.why: Several years of prior legislative service puts him in the high band. His earlier work in nonprofit leadership, business management and campaign strategy adds to that. Committee seats were not counted.
